senses.gloss: The fourth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding to Gh.

m. (-घः)
1 A bell.
2 A rattling or gurgling sound.
f. (घा)
1 A tinkling ornament worn by women round the waist.
2 Striking, killing.
3 Wetting, sprinkling.
E.
हन to kill, affix ड, and घ substituted for the radical letter, or the same affix, with घृ to sprinkle, &c.
